name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's fascination with motorsport began during his university days, fueled by late-night viewings of Formula 1 races and a deep dive into automotive engineering. After graduating with honors, he landed a coveted position at a local racing team, quickly making a name for himself with his sharp technical insights and meticulous approach to problem-solving. His relentless pursuit of performance improvements and his ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies impressed the leadership at Iron Lynx, leading to his current role as Technical Director.

Wei approaches his role with a blend of pragmatism and innovation, always seeking to optimize the team's technical capabilities while fostering a collaborative environment. He believes that true success comes from empowering his team members and leveraging their diverse expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible. His distinctiveness lies in his ability to balance short-term gains with long-term strategic planning, ensuring that Iron Lynx remains competitive both on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei has a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief recap of the previous race's technical challenges.
